Your holdings: SMCI (-37.6%), SOXL (-76.64%), MU (-61.9%), and PLTU (-26.87%) are all deep in the red and flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are getting hammered.

Bottom line: You're heavily concentrated in names hit hard by this inflation news. Focus on managing your biggest losers and protecting your downside.
